name: Ace VeinMiner Enchantment
summary: Add-on for Ace VeinMiner: vein mining only works on tools with the new Veinmine enchantment.
description:
## Earn your vein miner

Ace VeinMiner Enchantment is our planned port of **VeinMiner Enchantment** by MiraculixxT, the add-on that locks vein mining behind a custom **Veinmine** enchantment. Install it next to Ace VeinMiner and only tools carrying the enchantment can vein-mine, still following every block group, rule and setting.

- **Veinmine enchantment** on pickaxes and other mining tools, from the enchanting table, villager trades and loot
- **Configurable**: max level, weight, enchanting costs, anvil cost, supported items, treasure, tradeable and lootable
- **Level gates**: VeinMiner's `minEnchantLevel` can require a higher level, for example ores only at level 2+

## Why it isn't out yet

This is an add-on to [Ace VeinMiner](/plugin/ace-veinminer), which is itself waiting on the Pumpkin plugin API, so it can't ship first. Pumpkin can already register custom enchantments, but plugins can't yet set the enchanting-table costs or choose whether the enchantment shows up in the table, trades and loot.

needs.why: This is an add-on: it only gates VeinMiner's vein mining behind the enchantment. It ships once Ace VeinMiner can (world.break-block as the player, tool damage, tag lookups, world.drop-stack).
The enchanting-table level range (minCost 15, maxCost 65, plus per-level steps) has no field in custom-enchantment, so the table can't offer it at the right levels.

The inEnchantingTable, tradeable, lootable and treasure settings work by adding the enchantment to #minecraft:in_enchanting_table, #tradeable, #on_random_loot and #treasure. Plugins can't add a custom enchantment to tags yet.
